decisions.decision: cropperjs v2.1.1's <cropper-image> does not dispatch an externally-observable load event (its internal Image lives in its own shadow root); used the library's public $ready() promise instead
decisions.rationale: Verified directly against node_modules/cropperjs/dist/cropper.esm.js during 04-02 execution — resolves RESEARCH.md Open Question #2 concretely. Downstream plans (04-04/05/06 wiring ImageCropModal) should reuse this pattern rather than re-deriving it.

decisions.decision: Two Rule-1 bug deviations fixed during 04-03, both isolated to the new WebApplicationFactory test harness: (a) config override switched from ConfigureAppConfiguration to builder.UseSetting(...) since Program.cs reads Jwt:Secret too eagerly; (b) CreateAuthenticatedClient's manual Cookie header needed HandleCookies=false on the HttpClientHandler, since the default cookie-container handler silently overwrote it
decisions.rationale: Found while writing 04-03's endpoint tests; documented in 04-03-SUMMARY.md. Not production-code changes.

decisions.decision: Post-merge build/test gate runs dotnet build Omphalos.slnx + dotnet test + npm run build explicitly every wave, rather than relying on the generic single-command auto-sniff in post-merge-gate.md
decisions.rationale: This is a mixed .NET + npm repo with no workflow.build_command/test_command configured in .planning/config.json. The generic sniff would pick npm run build/npm test only (since package.json exists) and silently skip the entire .NET side — exactly the side Wave 1/2 touched most. Continue running both stacks explicitly for Waves 3 and 4.

next_action: Run /gsd-execute-phase 4 to resume — it will detect 04-01/02/03 have SUMMARY.md and skip them, then dispatch Wave 3 (04-04 + 04-05 in parallel worktrees), then Wave 4 (04-06).
